answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a bond in a shared vault before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. The protocol limits each bond to one active identity at a time and slashes it when independent reviewers confirm fraud, so creating a swarm does not multiply influence for free. A sybil attacker must lock real capital per identity, keep it tied up while building reputation, and risk losing it; the dune of cheap accounts becomes a costly pearl trail back to the attacker’s vault.
